annotations.title: Tx status, receipt, decoded logs, revert reason

description: Did a tx land on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param; the hash only exists on the chain it was sent to)? Given a hash: not_found / pending / confirmed / reverted, block and confirmations, gas fee, decoded logs (ERC-20 Transfer/Approval, fee-router swaps, staking, pair Swap/Sync), per-token balance changes, decoded calldata for BlazarForce contracts, and the revert reason (replayed). Pass from to also get latest vs pending nonce. Use after every send, and before ever re-sending: never blind-retry.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

from.description: Optional sender: adds latest vs pending nonce (useful when the hash is unknown).

name: blazar_tx_status
title: Tx status, receipt, decoded logs, revert reason
